hook.name: OreHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a Bitcoin-inspired proof-of-work mining protocol over an ETH/HBTC pool. Buy-side swaps pay an ETH toll (1–10%) that credits hashpower toward HBTC block rewards; tolls flow into a Burn Net that places maker limit orders and burns HBTC. Public trading is locked for the first 144 blocks after genesis.
